profile.primary_concern: fear of stigma and lack of access

context: As a young woman experiencing homelessness, I often feel overwhelmed by my situation. I worry that my living conditions will prevent me from getting the healthcare I need, including PrEP. The fear of judgment from healthcare providers makes me hesitant to seek help. Despite knowing that PrEP could protect me, I feel uncertain and anxious about accessing it.
